initialExam.title: Indian Navy SSR (Sailor) 2026
initialExam.description: Senior Secondary Recruit entry in Indian Navy for sailors. Candidates serve on warships, submarines, and naval establishments.
initialExam.eligibility: 12th pass with Physics, Math + one of Chemistry/Biology/CS (min 50%)
initialExam.syllabus: English, Mathematics, Science (Physics & Chemistry), General Knowledge.
initialExam.examPattern: Written: 100 questions, 100 marks, 60 minutes. Physical Fitness Test.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Exam → Physical Fitness Test → Medical → Merit List
initialExam.careerGrowth: Sailor → Leading Seaman → Petty Officer → Chief Petty Officer → Master Chief Petty Officer.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit joinindiannavy.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Appear for exam
initialExam.perks: Free food, Accommodation, Medical, Uniform, Travel concessions
